# Virtual Leather

> Virtual Leather makes personalized leather goods by hand in Colombia: made-to-measure leather aprons (BBQ, chef, barber, woodworking, tattoo and forging), knife rolls, backpacks and duffle bags, engraved with the customer's name, phrase or logo. Customers design their piece online at https://virtualleather.net, approve a design proof before it is made, and it is shipped worldwide with tracking. Prices are in US dollars; aprons start at $185 with engraving included and free US shipping.

Key facts:

- Seller: Virtual Leather Intl (Virtual Leather), a sole trader based in the UK; founder Daniel Guanes. Products are handmade in Colombia.
- Personalization: names, short phrases, dates, monograms and logos, laser engraved. A free online designer on the website shows a live preview; a design proof is sent by email or WhatsApp before production.
- Fit: aprons are made to measure from the wearer's height and weight.
- Leather: full-grain leather of the highest quality (natural marks and wrinkles kept) from Colombia, 1.6 mm thick.
- Timing: made in 1 to 3 days after the design proof is approved, then shipped from Colombia by FedEx or DHL with tracking. Delivery usually takes 3 to 5 days to the US and 5 to 7 business days to Europe. Shipping is free to the US, and US import duties are paid by us, so US buyers pay nothing on delivery. Shipping to Europe (including the UK) is $15 per order; everywhere else it is free.
- Care: leave the leather untreated for a vintage look that develops quickly, or treat it every few months with the leather care grease to keep it moisturized and looking new.
- Business and team orders: aprons with a company logo for restaurants, cafés, barbershops, breweries and teams; prices for several aprons are agreed directly (WhatsApp or email).
- Gifts: popular for Father's Day, birthdays, Christmas, BBQ lovers, chefs, barbers, woodworkers and tattoo artists.
- Contact: WhatsApp +44 7552 809738, email danielguanes@virtualleather.info, Instagram @virtualleatherintl (https://www.instagram.com/virtualleatherintl/).
- Order online: https://virtualleather.net/shop/ (secure checkout) or design an apron at https://virtualleather.net/#design.

## Frequently asked questions

### How do you size the apron?

Every apron is made to measure from the wearer's height and weight. Our standard size is 56 × 76 cm (width × length) for 1.70 to 1.75 m. Shorter people get a shorter apron (from 70 cm long), taller people a longer one (up to 90 cm), and a larger build gets our wider cut (60 cm). The neck and waist straps are adjustable.

### Will I see my design before you make it?

Yes. Before production we send you a design proof by email or WhatsApp. We only start making your apron once you approve it.

### What can you engrave?

Names, short phrases, dates, monograms and logos, in the positions shown on our apron sketch. Two engravings are included in the price (the chest, spots 1 and 2, counts as one), and each extra spot is $5.

### Do you have discounts or special offers?

Offers, and prices for business, team and multi-apron orders, are agreed directly with us. Message us on WhatsApp or email and we'll talk it through.

### Do you ship worldwide, and how long does it take?

Yes. Every apron is handmade in Colombia in 1 to 3 days after you approve the design proof, then shipped by FedEx or DHL with a tracking number. Delivery usually takes 3 to 5 days to the US and 5 to 7 business days to Europe. Shipping is free to the US, with import duties paid by us, and $15 per order to Europe.

### What leather do you use?

Full-grain leather of the highest quality, from Colombia, 1.6 mm thick. It softens and gains character with use.

### How do I look after my leather apron?

Wipe it with a damp cloth and let it dry naturally, away from direct heat. For a vintage, worn-in look, leave the leather untreated and it will age quickly. To keep it moisturized and looking new for longer, treat it every few months with our leather care grease.
